Soundness rides the attach's own freshness contract (the resume cursor's): the worker's monotonic event sequence bumps on every transcript change (appends, tool settles, the same-count in-place stream growth, compaction rewrites), a worker restart changes the generation, a different session changes the id — a match means the packs were rendered from exactly the entries the rebuild pushed. parity_notes: TUI OUTPUT BYTES: the re-entry renders the same frames off the adopted packs (pack storage is output-neutral — the tui-scroll-retain2 contract; the per-leg frames/bytes identical across the ABBA arms at every class; the unit full-frame oracle; the real-daemon round-trip e2e). MEMORY: the held packs are the visible window's entries only (canon: 1 pack ~4.6MB between the surfaces — the same packs that already stay resident during a run; ordinary classes: a few KB); the slot is one process-wide and the next handoff overwrites it.
